title: How to Save Without Losing It to Inflation (Sound Money) #soundmoney #islamicfinance
description:
You cannot out-save money that is designed to shrink. So stop saving in it.

For five thousand years money was a weight — gold, silver, salt, cattle. Nobody could type it into existence. You had to dig it, weigh it, carry it. That effort is what made it honest.

Then paper arrived as a receipt for the gold. Light, convenient, trusted. Then one day the receipts stopped being backed. Same paper, no gold behind it. Nothing changed on the note; everything changed underneath it.

Sound money passes three tests. It is SCARCE — nobody can make more on demand. It is DURABLE — it survives time. And it is YOURS — you hold it, not a promise to pay you. If someone else can print it, it was never yours.

So hold what cannot be diluted: weight you control, ownership that earns, and a home you live in rather than one that owns you. Keep a few months of cash for life, and no more.

And avoid the trap: borrowing at interest to escape inflation only feeds inflation. Interest is the engine that shrank the money in the first place.

Part 15 of The Money Machine, Decoded.
